summary: No reachable vulnerabilities. Hidden information (REQ-025): the hint request sends only playerView(table.hand, userSeat) (player-view.ts copies fields by name; only the viewer's own hole cards) plus userObservedSnapshot, which carries seat/hands/vpip/pfr built by handStyleCounts from public actions, board length and result awards of CompletedHand records; no opponent hole cards are read. The user's seat is excluded because botIds has no entry for it. hintCard reads only rec, the user's view and tableView names; chart-basis opponents use basisText(null). Observed snapshot comes only from completed hands: countObserved is called only in the step==='done' branch after completedHand(table) returns non-null, and the counts live in a per-mount ref (not persisted, so no stored-data tampering path). Worker boundary: advice-service validates request shape, and observedBySeat rejects bad seats/numbers/duplicates; responses are matched by id and stale replies are dropped by the HandState decision token. Rendering: HintCard renders every string as React text children (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere in src/); worker-derived strings come from authored templates anyway. No new dependencies, no network, no randomness, no secrets; console.error on hint failure logs only the worker error name/message.
